title: Determinants Lab
description: Interactive companion to Chapter 2 of Leon, Linear Algebra with Applications: cofactor expansion, determinants as signed area, elimination, Cramer's rule and coded messages.
lede: One number decides whether a square matrix can be inverted. Here you can compute it three ways (cofactors, elimination, geometry), see why row operations change it the way they do, solve systems with Cramer's rule, and decode a hidden message. Every exercise is checked exactly.
